name: chinese_to_english_benchmark
description: A community-contributed dataset of Chinese→English sentence pairs intended to evaluate machine translation models. It is typically used to measure translation fluency and adequacy across short-to-medium-length sentences and domains represented in the collection. Commonly used with automatic MT metrics for quick benchmarking of Chinese→English systems.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption for quick Chinese→English MT experiments.
